goal: `mc dev open <surface> [--account <name>] [--onboarding] [--viewport <v>] [--open]` is one call that ends with the app where the work is: this worktree's server up (started, or restarted after edits), signed in as the asked account in the asked onboarding state, on the surface, and one line printed: the URL, account/state, branch @ commit. With `--open` a headed browser at that viewport is left open for a person.
`mc dev surfaces` lists the surfaces memoro declares, one line each, and the accounts with their onboarding states.
`mc shot` and `mc dev open` take accounts and onboarding states from memoro's `.mc/shot.json` `accounts` table instead of knowing `seeded`/`new` and `ready=1`/`reseed=1` themselves.
`mc shot dev <surface> --compare <ref>` pictures and measures the same surface on this worktree and on `<ref>` in one call, and prints both PNG paths and the measured numbers that differ.

success_criteria.criterion: From a memoro worktree, `mc dev open assistant --account new --viewport iphone --open` returns within the server's start time, leaves a headed browser on the main chat at 390×844, and prints one line with the URL, `new/done` and the branch @ commit.
success_criteria.check: `mc dev open assistant --account new --viewport iphone --open; echo exit $?` prints a line containing `/dev/login?account=new&ready=1&next=%2Fapp%2Fassistant` and `new/done`, then `exit 0`; `pgrep -f scripts/shot/shot.mjs` prints a pid until the window is closed, and nothing after.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc dev surfaces` lists every target memoro's `.mc/shot.json` declares, with its path and summary, and the accounts with their states.
success_criteria.check: `mc dev surfaces` from a memoro worktree prints lines for `assistant`, `inbox`, `mail`, `library`, `reader`, `onboarding` with their summaries, and `accounts: seeded (done, fresh) · new (done, fresh)`.

success_criteria.criterion: Before and after in one call: `mc shot dev assistant --viewport iphone --scroll @end --measure @layout --compare origin/main` prints this tree's PNG path, origin/main's PNG path, and the differing numbers or that there are none.
success_criteria.check: Run it from a memoro worktree with an edit to `public/css/features/assistant-window/_index.css` (e.g. the footer's bottom offset); lines 1 and 2 are existing `.png` files, and a `diff` line names `.assistant-layout__footer` with `ref → here` values. Revert the edit afterwards.

success_criteria.criterion: The account comes from the table: `mc shot dev home --account review` is refused with the declared names, and `mc shot dev onboarding --account new --viewport iphone` signs in through `/dev/login?account=new&reseed=1` because the surface declares `onboarding: fresh`.
success_criteria.check: `mc shot dev home --account review` exits 2 with `--account is one of seeded, new`; `mc shot dev onboarding --account new --viewport iphone --json` exits 0 and its picture is the onboarding (`url` ends in `/app/`).

steps.title: mc shot reads accounts and onboarding states from .mc/shot.json; @end and @<name> without a selector
steps.done_when: `mc shot dev` builds its sign-in URL from the `accounts` table (falling back to today's behaviour when memoro declares none), `--scroll @end` passes a null selector, `tests/mc/shot.test.js` covers both, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: resolveAccount (src/mc/shot.js) reads the accounts table from .mc/shot.json; mc shot dev resolves the account before starting a server. Without a table it falls back to DEV_ACCOUNTS and the two /dev/login paths mc built before. A target's own onboarding: fresh applies without --onboarding. parseScroll: an empty selector before @end/@top/@<px> gives selector null (memoro resolves the declared scroller). --list prints an accounts block when there is a table. Not verified live: no memoro .mc/shot.json with accounts was run against a dev server here; tests use fixtures. Success criteria in PLAN.json are not marked met by this step.

steps.title: mc dev open <surface> and mc dev surfaces
steps.done_when: `mc dev open` and `mc dev surfaces` exist as specified, `tests/mc/dev-open.test.js` covers them with injected server, git and spawn, success criteria 1 and 2 pass from a memoro worktree on this machine, and `mc gate` is green.

steps.title: mc shot dev --compare <ref>: both trees, both pictures, the numbers that moved
steps.done_when: `mc shot dev <target> --compare <ref>` captures this worktree and `<ref>` with one request, prints both paths and the measurement diff (or `--json` with both results and the diff), `tests/mc/shot-compare.test.js` covers the tree, the diff and the output, success criterion 3 passes from a memoro worktree, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: deps:prepare in a compare tree writes npm's stdout to stderr (stdio ['ignore', 2, 'inherit']), not 'inherit' as the instruction said: on the first hand run npm's lines landed before the PNG path on stdout, breaking the path-alone-on-line-1 contract. Criterion 3 was verified from a scratch memoro worktree at origin/main because ~/mc/plan/mc/memoro is on an old plan branch without the accounts table or @layout.
